u0: No client is currently waiting and no unfulfilled task obligation is outstanding. When the next client arrives, the order must be taken, food fetched from the pantry, prepared at the stove, and served. If carried food slips, it must be picked up on the very next step; otherwise the task fails.
u1: The food has just slipped out of the hands and now lies nearby. The client's full sequence and the slipped food's pickup are still unresolved, so the agent must regain the food immediately on the next step. Losing the food while no one is waiting still leaves all future clients to be handled.
u10: The food has slipped while a client is waiting whose order is taken. Nothing else has been prepared or served, so the agent must recover the food at once, then fetch/prepare food and serve the waiting client.
u11: The food has slipped, and although the client's order was not recorded as taken, the serve obligation appears addressed. The agent must still pick the slipped food up on the very next step to avoid failure; subsequent arrivals each require the full routine.
u12: The food has slipped after the order was taken and the client served, so the client's sequence is closed. The remaining immediate obligation is to pick the food up on the next step; otherwise the task fails.
u13: Food has slipped and prepared, but the waiting client's order has not yet been taken. The agent must retrieve the food on the very next step, then take the order and serve; missed pickup fails the task.
u14: The food has slipped and prepared, the order is taken, and only serving awaits. The agent must pick the slipped food up on the next step, then serve it to the waiting client; failure to pick it up ends the episode.
u15: The food has slipped while the client's order was untaken and serving has been done. The agent must still pick the food up on the very next step; the next client will restart the full take-fetch-prepare-serve process.
u16: The task has failed irrevocably: either carried food slipped and was not picked up on the very next step, or a waiting client's chain of obligations could no longer be met. Successful completion is no longer possible.
u2: A client has arrived and is waiting, but nothing has been done for them yet: the order is still untaken and any later slips are unhandled. The remaining work is to take the order, fetch food from the pantry, prepare it at the stove, and serve it; any slip during this must be recovered on the next step.
u3: A waiting client's order has been taken, but no food has been prepared or served for them yet. The agent still needs to fetch food from the pantry, prepare it at the stove, and hand it over; any slip of carried food must be picked up on the next step.
u4: The client has been served, but no new order had been taken at this point, so the order-taking obligation is complete for that client. The next arrival will again require taking the order, fetching and preparing food, and serving it, with any slippage recovered immediately.
u5: The client's order was taken and the order was served, completing that client's sequence. No further obligation remains for this client; the agent is ready to handle the next arrival through the same take-fetch-prepare-serve routine.
u6: Food has been prepared at the stove (or is being handled), but the client's order is still untaken. The agent must still take the order and eventually serve the prepared food; slips of carried food remain recoverable only by an immediate pickup.
u7: The order is taken and food is prepared, so only the serving step remains for this client. The agent must hand the prepared food to the waiting client; a slip of the carried food must still be picked up on the next step.
u8: The client has been served, yet the order had not been recorded as taken. The sequence for this client is closed and the next arrival will require the full take-fetch-prepare-serve routine, with any slip picked up immediately.
u9: Food has slipped and is lying nearby while a client waits with the order already taken. The agent must pick the food up on the very next step, then carry on preparing and serving; failing to retrieve it on that next step ends the task.
